title: Electric Beach Snorkeling with Dolphins Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This Tour have become an extremely popular attraction in many cities around the world. The EZ Raider is designed and made in Israel! We have become an experienced and professional operator of EZ- Raider tours as well.
We have been running these tours for over 2 years, receiving excellent reviews from our many clients. Our tours combine a special attraction with fascinating explanations presented by our guides regarding the city's history. You will see many of the famous sites and breathtaking landscapes as we glide through Hawaii. 

This tour will give you a glance of the special fusion of ancient and modern that is created in Hawaii. Interesting stories will be shared by our professional guides as we glide with our Segway through the streets.

The EZ-Raider tour is also perfect for your next corporate event as it combines great fun and excitement with a touch of challenge.
